CloneBlobsJson.description: Partial-clone blob filter: `"none"` or a byte limit.

CloneBundleJson.description: The server's prebuilt bundle a clone started from (`bundle-uri`).

bytes.description: Size of the bundle file in bytes.

resumed_from.description: Bytes an earlier, interrupted clone had already downloaded.

uri.description: Where the bundle was downloaded from.

ClonePhase.description: Timing for one step of the clone.

seconds.description: Wall-clock seconds spent in this step.

PromisorRemoteJson.description: One promisor remote the server advertised, and whether this client accepted it.

accepted.description: Whether the client accepted the remote, letting the server leave out what it holds.

filter.description: The partial-clone filter the server advertised for the remote.

name.description: Remote name as the server advertised it.

rejected.description: Why the remote was not accepted: `policy_none`, `unknown_remote`, `url_mismatch`, `field_missing`, `field_mismatch` or `not_partial`; `null` when accepted.

url.description: Advertised URL, with any credentials removed.

PromisorWarningJson.description: Something about the promisor exchange the client ignored or could not use.

code.description: `unknown_accept_value` (`promisor.acceptFromServer` is not a known policy, so nothing is accepted), `unknown_field` (a `promisor.checkFields` / `promisor.storeFields` entry is not a known field), `invalid_advertised_value` (an advertised field value was not stored because it is invalid) or `unusable_auto_filter` (an accepted remote's filter cannot be used by `--blobs auto`).

key.description: The config key concerned, for `unknown_accept_value` and `unknown_field`.

value.description: The ignored config value, or the unusable filter. Advertised values that were rejected as invalid are never shown (they may be tokens).

StoredFieldJson.description: A remote field written into local config from the server's advertisement.

field.description: `partialCloneFilter` or `token`. The value itself is never shown.

bare.description: Whether the clone destination is a bare repository.

bare_gitlink_paths.description: Gitlink paths with no `.gitmodules` entry (empty after checkout).

blobs.description: Partial-clone blob filter when `--blobs` was used (`"none"` or a byte limit).

branch.description: Branch checked out, or `null` when detached at a tag.

branches_with_commits.description: Remote branch names that have commits when `no_checkout_reason` is `unborn_default_branch`.

bundle.description: The server's prebuilt bundle the clone started from, when it offered one. `objects` and `bytes` include what it brought.

bytes.description: Pack bytes received during the fetch.

depth.description: Shallow depth when `--depth` or `--shallow` was used.

filter_auto.description: True with `--blobs auto`: the filter comes from the promisor remotes the server advertised and the clone accepted (`blobs` is the filter it resolved to).

filter_ignored.description: True when the server does not support filters: the `blobs` filter was not sent and every blob was downloaded (the clone is still configured as a partial clone).

no_checkout_reason.description: Why no working-tree checkout happened, when `files` is zero.

object_types.description: Objects received by type, or `null` when the pack was copied from a local repository without being re-indexed.

partial.description: True when the server applied the `--blobs` filter on the initial fetch.

path_collisions.description: Index paths that collided on a case-insensitive filesystem during checkout.

phases.description: Time spent in each step, in order.

promisor_remotes.description: Promisor remotes the server advertised, and whether the clone accepted each.

promisor_warnings.description: Promisor config or advertised values that were ignored or could not be used.

remote.description: Remote name configured for the source (`origin` by default).

seconds.description: Wall-clock seconds for the whole clone.

single_branch.description: Whether only one branch was fetched (`git clone --single-branch` semantics).

stored_fields.description: Remote fields stored from the advertisement (`promisor.storeFields`).

submodule_paths.description: Gitlink paths listed in `.gitmodules` (submodules grit does not fetch).

tag.description: Tag name when `-b` named a tag; omitted on branch checkout.

tag_fetch.description: Tag fetch mode used for the initial fetch: `all`, `following`, or `none`.

worktree_bytes.description: Total size of the checked-out files, in bytes.
